DHAKA, Aug. 25 (Xinhua) -- Security has been tightened in parts of Bangladesh's capital Dhaka as a coalition of left-wing political parties led by the Left Democratic Alliance (LDA) staged a half-day strike on Thursday.

The LDA, a combination of seven left-leaning political parties, called the nationwide strike for Thursday, protesting against an increase in fuel, fertilizer prices and prices of essential commodities.
